summary: Defined runtime-adapter-pack contract with semantic tool bindings, risk class mapping, optional dependency degradation and SecurityExecutionEngine authority.
acceptance_evidence: RuntimeAdapterPackV1 requires runtime-adapter-pack coordinates and semantic tool bindings.
RuntimeAdapterToolBinding rejects shell surfaces such as shell.exec and generic exec names.
Every adapter tool declares risk_class and policy_mapping.
Missing optional dependencies must degrade read-only before effects.

commands.summary: 18 ecosystem-filtered runtime contract tests passed, including adapter no-shell coverage.
agent_core 107, agentd 59, runtime_contracts 27 and security_execution 79 tests passed; doctests passed.

blocked_shortcuts: Adapter pack cannot expose arbitrary shell.
Adapter pack cannot mutate host state directly.
Adapter side effects cannot bypass SecurityExecutionEngine.
promotion_impact: Runtime adapters can be modeled as ecosystem artifacts without becoming a second side-effect runtime.
